context.hint: Apply outbound request policy to the initial destination and every redirect.
context.surface: A discovery client derives a request URL and follows redirects to fetch a descriptor.
assumptions: A stub transport and controlled clock can observe the request and deadline contract.

review.invariant: Supported identifier forms produce the expected descriptor when the destination policy permits them.
review.verification: Check the descriptor result and the transport call count for an approved identifier. Check denial before transport for disallowed address classes.

source_observation.summary: A fresh-copy replay preserved approved discovery and observed no transport call for denied address classes.
